defects.detail: 'posita fuerunt candelabra communia mensae ... & projectae ante candelabra per terram castaneae' -> 'the table candlesticks ... were placed on the floor' (per terram belongs to the chestnuts)
'paria caligarum' (pairs of hose) -> 'pairs of shoes'
'Je crois pouvoir encore assurer' -> 'I believe I can also ensure' (assert)

reason: French prose and the embedded Burchard Latin are both rendered completely; small slips on candelabra placement, caligae as 'shoes', assurer as 'ensure'.

defects.detail: opening '[la]grima no calles' (do not be silent at my tears) is dropped; translation starts 'for I am a stranger with You'
'oye .A. justedad, escucha mi cantico' -> 'hear, A., my song; hear my prayer' (justedad dropped, 'hear my prayer' added)
'La alma tuya y el cuerpo tu obra' -> 'Your soul and the body are Your work' (the soul is Yours)

reason: Ladino Kipur liturgy rendered line by line faithfully; drops the opening tear-clause, swaps 'justedad' for 'hear my prayer', and misparses 'la alma tuya'.

defects.detail: garbled 'ये पूर्वा हव्या सा वे के देश स्पर्श वा पूर्वे वेति हेमाद्रिः' rendered as confident 'Whether the ritual offerings should be performed on the earlier day or when there is a partial contact ... is a matter of debate'
'पवित्रार्पणं कुलधर्मो दोषे वा' (pavitra offering by family custom, or in case of defect) -> 'a family duty that must be performed despite any minor ritual defects'
'श्रावण लघ तृतीय कं जि लै सा परा' -> 'Regarding the third and fourth lunar days, they are preferred when they pervade the appropriate time'

reason: Gist (Hemadri, Nirnayamrita, Raksha-bandhan free of Bhadra, Sankata Chaturthi moonrise rule, Madhava, Shitala, Ashtami midnight) tracks the source, but several garbled OCR spans are smoothed into fluent rulings; I read this OCR'd Sanskrit weakly.

defects.detail: hail list 'ἀπαρκτίας καὶ θρακίας καὶ ἀργέστης' -> 'the north, the north-north-east, and the north-west' (thrascias rendered NNE here, NNW elsewhere)
note glosses 'aparktias' as 'north-north-east' while the text renders it 'the north'

reason: All wind classes (wet, hail, snow, hot, cloud-gathering, clear, hurricane, lightning) and the thistle-down sign are present; only inconsistent compass labels for thrascias/aparktias.

defects.detail: gloss on '秦获藜' as 'a variety of gentian' — the source describes a fragrant edible vegetable, not gentian
margin '益 詵' rendered 'Meng Shen, Riyong' — 'Riyong' has no counterpart in the OCR

reason: Collected explanations, qi/flavor, indications, seed poultice and the 醍醐菜 entry with Lei's Paozhi lun description all rendered; only an unsupported gentian gloss and an added 'Riyong' margin label.

defects.detail: 'כלומר מטה כי קבלת התורה גורמת השכנת השכינה' (i.e. below) -> 'This means the "bed" exists because the acceptance of the Torah...'
'נותן כח וחוזק בענפיו במטה מאד' (to its branches below) -> 'to the "branches" of the tribe'

reason: Alshich on Song 3:6-8 rendered fully (Torah acceptance, patriarchs as myrrh/frankincense/powders, negative/positive commandments, Temple as bed, sixty warriors); twice reads מטה (below) as bed/tribe.

defects.detail: '寒藤挂古松' -> 'withered vines hang from an ancient pine' (cold vines)

reason: Hanlin title, sobriquet, poems set to music, lingzhi/Three Purities boast, running-script judgment, Huaisu poem and stone-rubbing remark all = source; only 寒 as 'withered'.

defects.detail: 'حتى يحدث فيه خرج سال منه دم' (until a wound/abscess occurs in it from which blood flows) -> 'until it happens in it, it came out and blood flowed from it'
'لأنه لاوز خارج مع الأخلاط الباقية' -> 'because nothing else comes out with the remaining humors' and 'لكون عدا الأعضاء' -> 'because they are the limbs' — garbled OCR given definite sense

reason: Two senses of 'blood' and the breathing lemma are rendered, but the garbled latter half (لاوز, صلحون, عدا الأعضاء) is turned into assertions the OCR cannot support; my reading of this handwritten-OCR Arabic is moderate.

defects.detail: the whole kharaj list ('وخراج خوارزم ٤٢١٢٠ ... بخارى ١١٩٩٨٧٧ ... الشاش ١٨٠٠٠٠ ... خجندة ١٠٠٠٠٠') is absent; translation jumps from distances to customs duties
route 'وتأخذ من أسيبيجاب إلى ساوات بريدين ثم إلى بروجكت مثلهما ثم إلى تمياج مرحلة' is dropped, as is the Latin note on Kodama's Khorasan tribute (38,000,000 dirhems)
'إلى باب بريدين' (to Bab, two barids) -> 'to the gate of Baridayn'; 'سامعر بريدين' -> 'Sa'ar two stages'

reason: Renders the first itinerary and the customs/Nishapur sentence, but omits the Isbijab route, every kharaj figure for Khwarizm/Bukhara/Sughd/Shash/Farghana, and the editor's Latin commentary.
Title and prologue opening reproduced with modernized spelling (booke->book, Magicke->Magic); nothing wrong.

defects.detail: 'SPECTATISSIMO viro' -> 'most spectacular man' (most esteemed)
'Amplissimae Reipublicae Sedinensis' -> 'most amplified republic of Stettin' (most distinguished)

reason: Both dedicatees' titles and all 18 lines of the New Year/Christmas elegiacs rendered faithfully; awkward 'spectacular' and 'amplified' for honorific superlatives.

defects.detail: 'A duellist ... necessary adjunct to diplomacy' -> 'a professional duelist seems to have been considered a necessary part of diplomatic missions' ('professional' added)
'put a triumphant end to the argument' -> 'brought the argument to a sudden and triumphant end'; 'Theophania' -> 'Princess Theophania'

reason: English paraphrase keeps Otho/John XII, Liutprand's two missions, Louis d'Outremer at Ingelheim and all footnotes (with Latin translated); small embellishments 'professional', 'sudden', 'Princess'.

defects.detail: lines 181-191 ('Ductor in arma suos Libys ... nullo sulcantur uomere campi') — the armies' muster and the opening of Hannibal's speech (Saguntum, Alps, Eridanus, Trebia, Trasimene) — are absent; translation jumps from 'roseo cedebat Eoo' to 'Clarior his titulus'
'Titania ... nocturno mea lumine' glossed as 'Sun-god' — the nocturnal Titanian is the Moon
'Haec memorat' (he says this) -> 'He remembers these things'

reason: Satricus/Solimus suicide passage (167-180) and 192-195 are faithful, but eleven lines in the middle including the start of Hannibal's speech are silently dropped.

defects.detail: outer-circle inscription '... המלאך הגואל אותי מכל רע ... אמת וצדק ...' is never translated; only a corrupted note fragment 'emet ve-tzedek." This is a partial quote from Genesis 48:16' survives
top-edge 'בכח השם הגדול והנורא' (by the power of the great and awesome Name) is absent
<meta> dates the amulet 'likely from the 19th or 20th century' with no support in the source

reason: Angel names, Ana B'Koach phrases, fourfold YHWH, Ehyeh and bottom 'truth, kindness and peace' are rendered, but the top-edge and outer-circle inscriptions are lost in a garbled note.

defects.detail: '舞台云色ノ變體真空ニ歸す合からす' (it is not right that form's transformed body returns to true emptiness) -> 'Shundai says: The transformed body returns to true emptiness'
opening fragment 'き。手安然たるを以ての故に。兎角に同しからず。' is not rendered; '以上孤山' attribution dropped from 'The above is the first among the Buddha's disciples in wisdom'
'舞台' rendered 'Shundai'

reason: Heart Sutra commentary (度一切苦厄, explicit/secret prajna, Subhuti in Great Treatise, Shariputra etymology, mirror simile) rendered faithfully, but one doctrinal clause loses its negation and a few attributions/fragments drop.
